inferred_constraints.description: Order creation and payment processing must reside in the same service to guarantee transactional consistency.
Supplier and Procurement Management must be decoupled from Inventory and Storage Management to allow flexibility in sourcing.
Menu, Product and Experience Design Process should be closely integrated with Marketing, Loyalty and CRM Process to ensure brand coherence.
Quality, Food Safety and Risk Management Process must be tightly coupled with Kitchen Production and Service Preparation Process to maintain compliance.
Reservation, Table and Capacity Management Process should be integrated with Dine-In Service Delivery and Guest Experience Process for seamless guest handling.

systems_analysis.description: This system is responsible for managing financial transactions, order processing, and enhancing guest experiences across dine-in and delivery services. It ensures transactional consistency by integrating order creation with payment processing, aligning with financial compliance and service delivery processes.
systems_analysis.build_or_buy_rationale: While core financial management can be handled by existing ERP solutions, the integration with specific order and guest experience processes requires customization.

market_options.name: SAP S/4HANA
market_options.fit_rationale: Offers robust financial management capabilities with customization options for order processing.

market_options.name: Oracle NetSuite
market_options.fit_rationale: Provides comprehensive financial and order management features with flexibility for customization.

market_options.name: Microsoft Dynamics 365
market_options.fit_rationale: Supports financial operations with the ability to integrate custom order processing workflows.

systems_analysis.description: This system manages reservations, table allocations, and capacity planning to optimize dining experiences. It ensures efficient use of resources and enhances customer satisfaction by aligning reservation processes with real-time capacity data.
systems_analysis.build_or_buy_rationale: The system's requirements align well with existing reservation and table management software solutions.

market_options.name: OpenTable
market_options.fit_rationale: Widely used for managing restaurant reservations and table allocations.

market_options.name: Resy
market_options.fit_rationale: Offers comprehensive reservation management features tailored for dining establishments.

market_options.name: SevenRooms
market_options.fit_rationale: Provides advanced reservation and capacity management capabilities.

systems_analysis.description: This system focuses on managing marketing campaigns, loyalty programs, and customer relationships. It leverages CRM processes to enhance customer engagement and drive loyalty through targeted marketing efforts.
systems_analysis.build_or_buy_rationale: The system's functions are well-supported by existing CRM and marketing automation platforms.

market_options.name: Salesforce
market_options.fit_rationale: A leading CRM platform with extensive marketing automation capabilities.

market_options.name: HubSpot
market_options.fit_rationale: Offers integrated marketing and CRM solutions for customer engagement.

market_options.name: Adobe Experience Cloud
market_options.fit_rationale: Provides comprehensive tools for marketing and customer relationship management.

systems_analysis.description: This system manages event planning and business-to-business interactions, focusing on organizing events and maintaining B2B relationships. It integrates customer engagement strategies to enhance event experiences and business partnerships.
systems_analysis.build_or_buy_rationale: While event management software can cover core functionalities, customization is needed for specific B2B interactions and integrations.

market_options.name: Cvent
market_options.fit_rationale: Offers event management solutions with customization options for B2B interactions.

market_options.name: Eventbrite
market_options.fit_rationale: Provides event planning tools with potential for integration with B2B processes.

market_options.name: Bizzabo
market_options.fit_rationale: Supports event management with capabilities for customizing B2B engagement.

systems_analysis.description: This system handles supplier relationships, procurement processes, and invoice management. It ensures efficient supply chain operations by coordinating supplier profiles and procurement activities.
systems_analysis.build_or_buy_rationale: The system's procurement and supplier management needs are well-served by existing supply chain management solutions.

market_options.name: SAP Ariba
market_options.fit_rationale: A comprehensive solution for procurement and supplier management.

market_options.name: Coupa
market_options.fit_rationale: Offers robust procurement and supplier management features.

market_options.name: Oracle Procurement Cloud
market_options.fit_rationale: Provides extensive tools for managing procurement and supplier relationships.

systems_analysis.description: This system oversees inventory control, storage management, and kitchen production processes. It ensures efficient resource management and service preparation by aligning inventory records with kitchen operations.
systems_analysis.build_or_buy_rationale: While inventory management software can address core needs, customization is required for specific kitchen production workflows.

market_options.name: Fishbowl Inventory
market_options.fit_rationale: Supports inventory management with customization options for kitchen operations.

market_options.name: Oracle NetSuite
market_options.fit_rationale: Provides inventory control with flexibility for integrating kitchen processes.

market_options.name: BlueCart
market_options.fit_rationale: Offers inventory management tailored for food service operations.

systems_analysis.description: This system is responsible for ensuring food safety, quality control, and risk management. It integrates HACCP records with quality assurance processes to maintain high standards in food safety and risk mitigation.
systems_analysis.build_or_buy_rationale: The system's focus on specific food safety and risk management processes requires a tailored solution not fully covered by off-the-shelf software.

systems_analysis.description: This system manages the design and development of menus, recipes, and customer experiences. It aligns product design with customer preferences to enhance dining experiences and brand identity.
systems_analysis.build_or_buy_rationale: The system's unique focus on menu and experience design necessitates a custom-built solution to capture specific business needs.

systems_analysis.description: This system supports strategic planning and governance activities, focusing on developing and executing strategic plans. It ensures alignment of business objectives with governance processes to drive organizational success.
systems_analysis.build_or_buy_rationale: The system's strategic focus and governance requirements are unique to the organization, necessitating a custom-built solution.
